actual_task_instruction: My siblings and I are preparing a playlist for a roadtrip together. I prepared the initial playlist on Spotify and shared it with them on phone messages. They have replied with suggested changes. Please update this playlist accordingly.

packet_source.instruction: My siblings and I are preparing a playlist for a roadtrip together. I prepared the initial playlist on Spotify and shared it with them on phone messages. They have replied with suggested changes. Please update this playlist accordingly.

agents.actual_task_instruction: My siblings and I are preparing a playlist for a roadtrip together. I prepared the initial playlist on Spotify and shared it with them on phone messages. They have replied with suggested changes. Please update this playlist accordingly.
released_registered_requirements:
obtain added spotify.PlaylistSong records using models.changed_records,
and assert song_ids of the added playlist songs match private_data.to_add_song_ids.
assert song_ids of the removed playlist songs match private_data.to_remove_song_ids.
assert added and removed song ids have playlist_id = private_data.playlist_id
